messages:
Olivia Park: FYI incoming candidate Diego Morales (staff infra) visiting 2027-08-09. Diego will bring his 7yo child for the day and asked if we can provide a supervised quiet family room or recommend onsite childcare options. Also requested a car-seat-friendly parking spot and a highchair for lunch. Can we support?
Aimee Chen: We don't have internal childcare, but we can book a vetted vendor (Onsite Care Co.) for a 4h supervised room. Policy covers vendor costs with hiring manager approval. Raj, can you approve vendor spend?
Raj Patel: I can approve up to $150 for childcare per visit. Please get vendor certificate and background check confirmation.
Facilities: We can reserve Family Room E (ground floor, near lactation room) 08:30-17:00. It has a door, couch, changing table. We'll also move a small table and a kid-sized chair.
Front Desk: We'll hold an envelope "Diego Morales - Family Visit" with parking permit and highchair request. We'll also post temporary signage to Family Room E so other teams avoid it.
Olivia Park: Diego prefers a local vendor who can provide a caregiver and toys for the child. He also asked about reimbursement if he needs to arrange his own childcare last-minute.
Aimee Chen: Per hiring ops, last-minute childcare reimbursement allowed up to $100 with receipts and manager sign-off. We'll add that to the confirmation email.
Diego Morales: Thanks, team. Prefer the vendor for supervision. The child has a mild peanut allergy  no peanuts in snacks please. Also need the car-seat-friendly parking close to the west entrance.
Facilities: Noted allergy. We'll add "no peanuts" to catering and vendor notes. Reserved Parking Spot W-02 (curbside) for 08/09 07:30-18:00; it's car-seat accessible.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: family_room, vetted_vendor, parking_W-02, highchair, allergy_note, envelope_front_desk. Will post vendor confirmation when booked.
Aimee Chen: I reached out to Onsite Care Co. They can provide 1 caregiver 09:00-13:00 for $120 and liability insurance on file. They require a 30m setup before arrival; Facilities ok to allow.
Raj Patel: Approved. Please proceed with vendor booking and send invoice to finance.
Facilities: Setup approved. We'll prep Family Room E by 08:30 with a small play mat and kid table. Cleaning will do fragrance-free wipe-down prior to arrival.
Front Desk: We'll print the visitor pass and place the highchair in Family Room E. Envelope will include guidance sheet for parent/caregiver and ID check required on pickup.
Olivia Park: I'll send Diego a confirmation email with vendor name, reimbursement policy, parking spot, allergy note, and a map to Family Room E. Also include fallback: if vendor cancels, we'll provide a quiet desk for Diego and remote interview option for a 2-hour window.
Diego Morales: Appreciate it. Also can we have a short office tour for the child? Simple lobby tour only, please.
Aimee Chen: Sure, a 10-min escorted lobby tour at 12:45 is fine. Will note on the escort instructions that the child stays with caregiver.
PeopleOps Bot: Vendor Onsite Care Co. confirmed (service id OCC-452). Invoice pending. Flight/arrival monitor not needed for local commute.
Olivia Park: Final check: Raj approved spend, Facilities confirmed Family Room E and parking, Front Desk holding envelope, vendor confirmed. I'll send final candidate note now. Thanks team.
PeopleOps Bot: Thread closed: final checklist saved to candidate doc. :white_check_mark:
